meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 安装后，当需要迁移记忆时，Claude 会读取旧提供商的记忆存储，提炼出持久信息（如身份指令、用户偏好），然后写入新提供商的存储格式，并重启群组。它不会移动原始文件，只复制并去重。
howto.when: 当你说“migrate memory”、“legacy memory”或“the agent forgot everything after the switch”时触发。通常在你切换了群组的提供商（如从 Claude 切换到 Codex）后使用。

say.text: 迁移记忆，从 Claude 切换到 Codex。
把记忆从 Codex 搬回 Claude。
切换提供商后代理忘记了一切，迁移记忆。

howto.what_en: When asked to migrate memory, Claude reads the source provider's memory store, distills durable information (identity instructions, user preferences), writes it into the target provider's store format, and restarts the group. It copies, never moves, and deduplicates.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "migrate memory", "legacy memory", or "the agent forgot everything after the switch". Typically used after switching a group's provider (e.g., Claude to Codex).

say_en.text: Migrate memory from Claude to Codex.
say_en.note: Claude reads CLAUDE.local.md and writes into memory/ tree.

say_en.text: Carry memory over from Codex to Claude.
say_en.note: Claude reads memory/ tree and integrates into CLAUDE.local.md.

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch, migrate memory.
